description: This file provides formatting utilities for CLI output, including status and match formatting functions, as well as type guards and counters for container items.

methods.name: export function formatStatus(running: boolean): string { formatStatus
methods.description: Returns a colored status string indicating whether a process is running.

methods.name: export function formatSimpleStatus(running: boolean): string { formatSimpleStatus
methods.description: Returns a plain status string indicating whether a process is running.

methods.name: export function formatImageMatch(matches: boolean): string { formatImageMatch
methods.description: Returns a string indicating whether image matches or not, with symbols.

methods.name: export function countRunning<T extends { running: boolean }>(items: T[]): number { countRunning
methods.description: Counts the number of items in the array where 'running' is true.

methods.name: export function countMismatches<T extends { imageMatch: boolean }>(items: T[]): number { countMismatches
methods.description: Counts the number of items in the array where 'imageMatch' is false.
